server.name: io.onchainagentintel/agent-zero-intel
server.description: Free read-only ERC-8004 agent-intel tools: coverage, leaderboards, agent vetting, payment graph
server.title: Agent Zero — ERC-8004 Agent Intelligence

tools.name: get_coverage_stats
tools.summary: Live coverage of the ERC-8004 agent economy (Base/Ethereum/BNB): agents indexed, how many expose a live MCP server / OpenAPI / well-known card, total tools and methods observed, contracts verified, owners identified, per-chain breakdown. Counts only — no names, addresses, or handles.

tools.name: get_leaderboards
tools.summary: Top ERC-8004 agents by live MCP tool count and by OpenAPI method count, plus the most-recently indexed — each with agent_id, chain, public name, shareable detail URL, and the relevant count. Names and counts only.

tools.name: get_agent_summary
tools.summary: Objective counts-only signals for one agent: reachability, TLS validity, x402 support, payments-received (boolean), MCP tool count, OpenAPI method count, well-known presence, owner-named (boolean), and a neutral status label. Vet a counterparty agent before transacting.

tools.name: get_network_teaser
tools.summary: A capped teaser (<=200 nodes) of the on-chain agent-to-agent payment graph: connected agents and the value flowing between them. Truncated preview of the full paid graph.
